339-677-4247-8296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3277-4826-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
3277-4826-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Izzet Chronarch and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Izzet Chronarch and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
3277-4826-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Izzet Chronarch and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1981-2415-6495-6559.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.
1981-2415-6495-6559.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-2921-4506.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2921-4506.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

4186-5662-6797--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 5.

1099-2034-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Sling-Gang Lieutenant.
When Sling-Gang Lieutenant enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

206-4149-4599-4871-6019.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2034-5003-5434-6773.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

5319-5708-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
5319-5708-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Geralf's Messenger.
Geralf's Messenger dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Vein Ripper
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Geralf's Messenger trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Geralf's Messenger, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7338.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Putrid Pals.
When Putrid Pals dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7230.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost 2 or more life this turn.
2034-6972-7230.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cryptborn Horror.
When Cryptborn Horror dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

940-1491-5007.description:
Activate Morselhoarder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Morselhoarder by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Morselhoarder by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

436-4284-5220.description:
Cast Clone by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Put Clone into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Clone dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Clone from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Clone trigger, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put Clone onto the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Repeat from step 2.

3525-4644-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-671-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-671-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

465-3817-5231.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat from step 3.

2613-4090-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Spiteful Sliver instead due to Pariah.
Spiteful Sliver triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

2724-3582-3987-6797.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

198-203-4067-6571.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {W} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Anoint with buyback by paying {3}{W}.
Shantotto triggers, giving it +4/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Anoint.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

requires.n: Extra Turn Spell - GY on Resolution

864-5256-6490--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana available each turn to cast the extra turn spell and enough mana each extra turn to cast Eternal Witness.
You have not cast a spell using Kotis
864-5256-6490--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Eternal Witness, causing you to mill cards equal to Eternal Witness's power.
Cast Eternal Witness from your graveyard by paying its mana cost and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile the extra turn spell.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the extra turn spell from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4779-4871-6291.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

2018-2921-4053.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature that does not have flying.
2018-2921-4053.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature without flying.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
2018-2921-4053.notes: If you wish to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Bartolomé del Presidio, instead do not resolve its abilities, and then remove Solemnity from the battlefield. Then, resolve the abilities to get the +1/+1 counters.

719-1789-5231-5649.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
719-1789-5231-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4321-4508-5880-5929.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure and Food token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

640-3097-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

914-2187-5530.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2187-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Possessed Skaab.
When Dockside Extortionist and Possessed Skaab enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
914-2187-5530.notes: If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

238-1365-1477-2034.notablePrerequisites: Gerrard has no more than one -1/-1 counter on it.
238-1365-1477-2034.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Gerrard persist until end of turn.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron of Souls, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gerrard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gerrard, adding {C}{C}.
When Gerrard dies, it and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Gerrard persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Gerrard trigger, failing to exile it as it has left your graveyard, and returning Cauldron of Souls from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1049-2034-2440-4871.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{W}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable, or an additional {R}, {W} or {B} if you haven't cast Jirina from the command zone this game
1049-2034-2440-4871.description:
Cast Jirina from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{W}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Jirina enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Jirina trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token for each time you've cast Jirina from the command zone this game.
When the Human Soldiers enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Human and Soldier you control.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining Mana Echoes trigger created in steps 2 and 4.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Jirina and a Human Soldier, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Choose to return Jirina to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Jirina and the Human Soldier die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, if you control a Human Soldier, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Human Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
If you sacrificed a Human Soldier this way, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate up to three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding any combination of {R}, {W} and {B}.
Repeat.

5641-5783-5784.description:
Cast Plumecreed Mentor by paying {1}{W}{U}.
When Plumecreed Mentor enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that has flying and vigilance due to Aven Wind Guide.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Plumecreed Mentor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.
You may sacrifice the Eldrazi Spawns to get infinite {C}, if desired.

224-423-2167-2309-3143.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one land.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Fall of the Thran has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
224-423-2167-2309-3143.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Fall of the Thran triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Fall of the Thran's second or third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land can produce.
You may optionally repeat step 3 one additional time.
If Fall of the Thran has three loyalty counters on it, activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a lore counter from Fall of the Thran, causing you to populate.
Resolve the Fall of the Thran chapter trigger from step 2, causing each player to return two land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Whenever the land(s) enter the battlefield, Evolution Sage and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger for each land that entered the battlefield under your control.
Holding priority, if the land(s) enter the battlefield untapped, you may activate them by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the second Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, if applicable, either causing you to scry 1 or to tap or untap target creature.
Resolve the first Evolution Sage trigger, putting a lore counter on Fall of the Thran.
Repeat from step 2.
If applicable, resolve all remaining Evolution Sage triggers, causing you to proliferate that many times.
If you sacrifice and return two lands each cycle, this combo will net infinite untap of creatures you control and infinite scry 1.

1474-3489-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Nezumi Prowler does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
1474-3489-3542.description:
Declare Nezumi Prowler as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Nezumi Prowler from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Nezumi Prowler's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{B} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Nezumi Prowler onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

uses.n: Invasion of Alara // Awaken the Maelstrom

111-147.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
111-147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to defeat Invasion of Alara.
111-147.description:
Defeat Invasion of Alara, triggering it, causing you to exile it and cast Awaken the Maelstrom.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Awaken the Maelstrom, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Maelstrom, causing a player to draw two cards, then allowing you to put an artifact card from your hand onto the battlefield, then creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage, then putting three +1/+1 counters on creature(s) you control, and then destroying a permanent an opponent controls.
Repeat from step 3.

792-1580-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Totentanz triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {1}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

830-1819-4179.notablePrerequisites: You have at least ten creature cards in your graveyard.
830-1819-4179.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control +1/+1 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Bone Harvest by paying {2}{B}, putting at least ten creature cards on top of your library from your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that left your graveyard this way, giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

3129-3199-3209.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You control at least two untapped creatures, one of which must be green.
3129-3199-3209.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by tapping a green creature and any other creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat step 4.

1494-3021-4499.manaNeeded: {3} during the first turn, and every three turns afterwards
1494-3021-4499.notablePrerequisites: Sage of Hours does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1494-3021-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Conclave Sledge-Captain.
When Conclave Sledge-Captain enters the battlefield, its backup ability triggers three times, all targeting Sage of Hours.
Resolve all Conclave Sledge-Captain triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours, and causing it to gain the printed abilities three times until end of turn.
Deal combat damage with Sage of Hours, triggering its abilities granted by Conclave Sledge-Captain three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours for each damage it dealt.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least three extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your last extra turn.

1143-4031-4050-4763.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional Cleric or Rogue creature.
1143-4031-4050-4763.description:
Cast Ardent Electromancer by paying {2}{R}.
Ardent Electromancer enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Diviner's Wand.
Resolve Ardent Electromancer's trigger, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve Diviner's Wand's trigger, attaching it to Ardent Electromancer.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ardent Electromancer, adding one mana of any color.
Koll triggers, returning Ardent Electromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

1339-2034-3394.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2034-3394.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.
